00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000019.title: The white house
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000019.synopsis: Mara’s childhood home, above the village. Empty for twelve years and exactly as she left it, which is the problem.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000019.notes: The house remembers her at sixteen. Rooms should be slightly wrong: too small, too tidy.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000020.title: The bell tower
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000020.synopsis: A stone tower on a spit of land so narrow the sea passes beneath it. It has been on the east side of the island. It is currently on the west.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000020.notes: The tower is the visible proof that the island moves. Let it be seen from the boat first.
